name: daily_brief_asks_v6
description: Needs-you: explicit overseer Asks plus retained human-gate labels, with linked work, fallback and expiry. OPTIONS/REC are read per item on demand (daily_brief_ask_item_v1). Status is joined before priority; measured ~0.05-0.15s vs 2-10s for v5. Read-only source definition; registration is separate.
scope: every active explicit Ask or human-gated seed, excluding inbox and visible Later; up to 400 gate facts, overflow is UNKNOWN
template: PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/> PREFIX seeds: <https://seeds.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX ical: <http://www.w3.org/2002/12/cal/ical#> SELECT ?item ?id ?title ?priority ?rank ?status ?owner ?due ?revision ?modified ?created ?gate ?kind ?unblocks ?linkedResource ?default ?expires WHERE { GRAPH <https://seeds.local/project/aegis> { { VALUES ?gate { "blocked:human" "needs-stiwi" "decision-stiwi" "desk" "decision-needed" } ?item schema:keywords ?gate . } UNION { ?item seeds:issueType "ask" . BIND("ask-type" AS ?gate) } ?item seeds:status ?status . FILTER(?status != "closed" && ?status != "tombstone") FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item schema:keywords "inbox" } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item schema:keywords "stiwi-later" } ?item seeds:priority ?priority . OPTIONAL { ?item seeds:issueType ?kind } OPTIONAL { ?item seeds:unblocks ?unblocks . BIND(isIRI(?unblocks) AS ?linkedResource) } OPTIONAL { ?item seeds:askDefault ?default } OPTIONAL { ?item seeds:expiresAt ?expires } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:identifier ?id } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:name ?title } OPTIONAL { ?item seeds:rank ?rank } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:version ?revision } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:dateModified ?modified } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:dateCreated ?created } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:agent ?owner } OPTIONAL { ?item ical:due ?due } } } ORDER BY ?priority ?id ?gate LIMIT 400
